headlines.title: Polymarket briefly halts trading after third-party compromise and reports of stolen user funds
headlines.description: Predictions markets platform Polymarket was forced to halt trading on its international platform for an hour after a vendor was compromised.

headlines.title: AI fears hammer Google parent’s stock, erasing $500 billion in value
headlines.description: Shares of Google parent company Alphabet sank by as much as 15.8%, on course for the company’s worst single-day drop in history.

headlines.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, creating delivery giant
headlines.description: Delivery giant DoorDash is buying to-your-door grocery service Instacart for $17 billion, the company announced Thursday.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged in final vote before midterms
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve has voted to keep interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation. NBC News' Brian Chueng reports on the central bank's final rate decision before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Tools and Hacks to Find the Best Prices on Groceries, Gas, More
headlines.description: NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share tools to track down the biggest bargains and make sure you are getting the best price with the holidays approaching. Tips include using Google’s new Universal Cart for price tracking alerts, Upside to earn cashback on gas and more!

headlines.title: Walmart US CEO on Affordability, Whether It Will Use Dynamic Pricing
headlines.description: At a time when many Americans are feeling the pinch in their wallets, the nation’s largest retailer, Walmart, announced its lowest price yet for their 26-item Thanksgiving meal basket at just $35. Reporting for TODAY, NBC’s Savannah Sellers catches up with the company’s U.S. CEO, David Guggina, to discuss whether the retail giant is going to be able to keep overall prices down as costs continue to rise and if it is going to engage with dynamic pricing through digital shelf labels.

headlines.title: When to Grab the Best Deals on Everything From Food to Flights
headlines.description: From electronics to clothes, NBC News business and economy reporter Allie Canal joins TODAY to break down when to get the biggest savings.

headlines.title: Fed plans to eliminate some rate-setting meetings, chairman says
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve plans to eliminate some meetings devoted to setting interest rates in the next couple of years, Chairman Kevin Warsh said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation
headlines.description: The soaring costs of gas, diesel and crude oil are a major driver of higher prices across the U.S. economy.

headlines.title: Hasan Piker files $72.5 million defamation suit against Scott Jennings
headlines.description: The progressive pundit claims the conservative commentator deliberately distorted his remarks to falsely portray him as a supporter of lynching Black people.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll roll back Biden-era methane rules for oil and gas companies
headlines.description: The EPA plans to ease regulations aimed at curbing methane leaks, Trump said. The potent greenhouse gas is a major contributor to climate change.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.
